name: Yamaha RX50 / RX-S
engine: 49 to 98 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Autolube oil injection
intro: Yamaha's small two-stroke commuters. Autolube, points or CDI, and a simple chassis.

B: It has oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump line for cracks.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
